hypotheses.F0_full_coordinate_positive_control: All native and rotated 4,608-coordinate patches reach at least 0.999 median downstream fidelity in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.F1_no_tiny_family_circuit: Leave-one-pair-out native family banks remain below 0.25 median downstream fidelity at rank 32 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.F2_individual_edits_have_moderate_native: Per-example native-oracle banks reach 0.50 median downstream fidelity by rank 256 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.F3_reusable_family_banks_reach_half_fide: Leave-one-pair-out native family banks reach 0.50 median downstream fidelity by rank 1,024 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.F4_high_fidelity_requires_broad_native_b: No leave-one-pair-out native family bank reaches 0.90 median downstream fidelity before rank 2,048.
hypotheses.F5_native_advantage_persists_at_512: At rank 512, native leave-one-pair-out family fidelity exceeds the median rotated-family fidelity by at least 0.05 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.F6_rotation_converges_only_at_broad_rank: The median rotated leave-one-pair-out family bank does not reach 0.50 fidelity before rank 2,048 in any layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.F7_layer1_family_code_is_more_compact: Layer-1 native leave-one-pair-out family fidelity exceeds Layer 0 by at least 0.03 at rank 512 on both corpora.
